# Setup

```{r}
# Load packages
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, pacman, grateful, here, usethis)
```

```{r}
# Set blank slate
usethis::use_blank_slate(scope = "user")

# Citations
grateful::cite_packages(pkgs='Session', output='paragraph', out.dir='.')
print(paste("operating system: ", sessionInfo()$running))

# Check working directory
here()
```

# Data processing

## Load raw data

```{r}
# Load in the raw data
load(here("data", "raw", "acupuncture_data_reduced.RData"))
acupunc_full <- data
```

## Recode categorical variables as factor

```{r}
# sex: 2 values, 1=female, 0=male
acupunc_full$sex <- factor(data$sex, 
                           levels = c(1, 0), 
                           labels = c("female", "male"))

# migraine: 2 values, 1=migraine, 0=tension-type
acupunc_full$migraine <- factor(data$migraine, 
                                levels = c(1, 0), 
                                labels = c("migraine", "tension-type"))

# group: 2 values, 1=acupuncture, 0=control
acupunc_full$group <- factor(data$group, 
                             levels = c(1, 0), 
                             labels = c("acupuncture", "control"))

# acupuncturist: 12 unique values, numbered 1 to 12
acupuncturist_int <- seq(min(data$acupuncturist),
                         max(data$acupuncturist)) # vector of numeric values
acupuncturist_str <- as.character(acupuncturist_int) # vector of character values
acupunc_full$acupuncturist <- factor(data$acupuncturist, 
                                     levels = acupuncturist_int, 
                                     labels = acupuncturist_str)

# GP: 36 unique integer values; not numbered in an obvious way
gp_int <- seq(min(data$practice_id), 
              max(data$practice_id)) # vector of potential numeric values
gp_str <- as.character(gp_int) # vector of potential character values
acupunc_full$gp <- factor(data$practice_id, 
                          levels = gp_int, 
                          labels = gp_str)

# patient ID: 401 unique integer values; not numbered in an obvious way
id_int <- seq(min(data$id), 
              max(data$id)) # vector of potential numeric values
id_str <- as.character(id_int) # vector of potential character values
acupunc_full$id <- factor(data$id, 
                          levels = id_int, 
                          labels = id_str)
```

## Save the full recoded data

```{r}
# Drop redundant variable practice_id (the numeric version of GP)
acupunc_full <- acupunc_full %>% select(-practice_id)

# Check the recoded data
summary(acupunc_full)

# Save as .RData to data/processed
save(acupunc_full, file = here("data", "processed", "acupunc_full.RData"))
```

## Save the migraine-only recoded data

```{r}
# Filter out tension-type patients
acupunc <- acupunc_full %>% filter(migraine == "migraine")

# Check the filtered data - this will be used for analysis
summary(acupunc)

# Save as .RData to data/processed
save(acupunc, file = here("data", "processed", "acupunc.RData"))
```
